hook_text: One frame, one crank, one moving thing inside. That is your whole term, and here is the plan.
clip_script: This term you build a frame with a mechanism inside. You turn a crank; gears, a cam or a pulley make something move; a bucket lifts or a barrier rises. It solves a problem for a community, and that scenario is your exam question. Five steps, you know them from Grade 7. Investigate: study pylons and winches, weeks four and five. Design: brief, sketches, a working drawing with millimetres, week six. Make: build it safely, week seven. Evaluate: test it against your own list and tell the truth, week eight. Communicate: present it, week nine. The frame and the mechanism meet at the holes where the axles go through, so plan those first. And every sketch, every note, into the portfolio, because that is where the marks live. One frame, one crank, five steps, one term.
visual_style: Whiteboard timeline of weeks 4 to 9 with an IDMEC letter dropping onto each; a frame outline grows uprights, braces, then a crank and gear inside; a bucket rises on a string.
pacing: Scenario in ten seconds, five steps in thirty, the bearing tip and the portfolio reminder to close.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write your team's one-sentence version of the scenario.
